prerequisites: at least 7 years of school knowledge in the foreign language

learning_outcomes.text: Students will generally have foreign language skills comparable to level C1 according to the CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages).
Students will possess sufficiently detailed knowledge of presentation techniques to present on a demanding subject-specific topic to an international audience.
Students will have knowledge of other cultures and be able to successfully apply this knowledge in professional communication.
Students will master the confident use of the foreign language as well as work techniques to comprehend, reflect on, and discuss technical texts in a group.
Students will be able to communicate competently and articulately in the foreign language about complex technical matters with foreign interlocutors.
Students will possess cultural empathy and thus be able to communicate confidently and successfully in an international context/team.

syllabus_topics: Exercises to train communication skills with current texts selected from technical specializations
Intensive training of presentation techniques based on technical topics
Group discussions of current technical topics
Cultural briefings and case studies to heighten awareness of intercultural differences

assessment_methods.method: Presentation with accompanying elaboration (within the portfolio examination)

assessment_rules: The portfolio examination is worth 40 points and consists of an oral examination and a presentation with an accompanying elaboration. A maximum of 20 points can be achieved with the oral examination, and a maximum of 20 points can also be achieved with the presentation. The duration of the presentation is approximately 10-12 minutes, and the accompanying elaboration is approximately 2-3 pages. Details for the oral examination are in the general part of the examination regulations.
